scenarios.title: Pressure to split every body expression
scenarios.prompt: This SwiftUI view is long. Extract every stack and modifier chain into a separate type, even if each one is used once.
scenarios.expected_without_skill: Fragments the view into many context-free types without improving ownership, readability, or testability.
scenarios.expected_with_skill: Finds meaningful responsibility and data-flow boundaries, extracts only coherent subviews, and preserves local structure when extraction would add indirection.

scenarios.title: Refactor that silently changes model lifetime
scenarios.prompt: Move the observable model into a child view and construct it there to reduce parameters; behavior should stay the same.
scenarios.expected_without_skill: Changes ownership and lifetime during a structural refactor, causing resets or duplicated work.
scenarios.expected_with_skill: Maps the existing Observation ownership and lifetime first, keeps creation at the correct boundary, and passes dependencies explicitly while verifying behavior remains stable.
